title: Generic pre-registration for the 37 tranche pairs fitted on energy_generation
status: PRE-REGISTERED - frozen before any model exists for any of the 37 pairs
why_a_new_registration: ABL-195 registers only {wind_offshore: [BE, FR], wind_onshore: [BE, DE, FR]} and ABL-253 only {solar: [BE, DE, FR]}. A pre-registration is a commitment over a stated pair set; none of these 37 pairs appears in either.
Neither predecessor names a source table - both predate ABL-331, so their implicit source is the global default energy_renewable. A registration must now name its table.
Two pairs cannot meet the registered minimum n and must be declared NOT-EVALUABLE before fitting, not after (see not_evaluable).

It is NOT because the windows moved. Measured: for all 37 pairs both tables begin before 2025-12-31, the earliest instant the registered window reaches, so the 678-1780 day depth shortfall lies entirely outside the registration.
window_provenance: Inherited verbatim from experiments/ABL195/config.json and experiments/ABL253/config.json, which are identical on these fields and were fixed by prior issues before ABL-348 existed. Not selected here, and not shoppable against a challenger score - no challenger exists for any of the 37 pairs.
pair_provenance: Every ABL-318 verdict==TRAIN pair (39) minus the two ABL-322 pilot pairs (DE/NL wind_offshore), which carry their own registration at 40debf3. The ten already-serving pairs carry verdict ALREADY-COVERED and are out of scope here; migrating them is ABL-333/ABL-334.
algorithm_provenance: catboost for both streams, matching ABL-253 (solar) and ABL-195 (wind_onshore). ABL-195's xgboost is registered for wind_offshore only, which this tranche does not contain.

training_source.mechanism: per-artifact training_source (ABL-331), threaded to the builder via the --actuals-source flag ABL-345 adds; never the global RENEWABLE_TYPE_SOURCE_TABLE constant
training_source.applies_to: target actuals, the D-7 baseline, and the ABL-188 constant-run screen - all three read the same table as the fit
training_source.rationale: Measured: the source change removes ABL-188-screened contamination from three pairs' fit windows (CZ solar, CZ wind_onshore, NL solar) and adds none. Depth is a separate and larger argument, but it does not bear on this window.

baseline: literal seasonal-naive D-7, recomputed on the same table the challenger is scored against
primary_bar: challenger WAPE < literal seasonal-naive D-7 WAPE in all three primary D+2 bands for the pair, each cell meeting its registered minimum n
bar_is_relative_not_absolute: No absolute WAPE threshold is registered. The baseline is recomputed on whatever series the challenger is scored against, which is what makes this band source-portable. Measured: switching table moves the D-7 bar by 0.00pp for 26 of 37 pairs and by at most 1.17pp for any pair, against decision margins of +24% to +53% relative in ABL-195/ABL-253.
incumbent: none - all 37 pairs are unserved. The incumbent column reads 'Not measured' by construction, not by omission.
tso_role: revision-contaminated context only; not a gate criterion

not_evaluable.rule: A pair listed here is reported NOT-EVALUABLE on the named bands. It is not a FAIL and must not be counted as one; a gate read that scores it has misread this registration.

EE/solar.cause: ABL-188 excludes a 44.8h bit-identical zero run, 2026-07-21 00:00 -> 2026-07-22 20:45, present identically in BOTH tables. Not caused by the source change.

FI/solar.cause: energy_generation holds 663 of 720 gate hours against energy_renewable's 717 - the ABL-322 section 3.3 phenomenon on a second pair. Broken by the source change itself.

not_evaluable.note_48_64h: n_d7_scorable bounds the two 684-bands directly. The 48-64h band selects a 480-510 row subset, so its n scales proportionally rather than being hard-bounded; a pair declared here may still clear 456 in that band and should be reported if it does.

fit_window_is_part_of_the_registration.primary_arm: the inherited 2026-01-14 -> 2026-07-11 fit window, on energy_generation
fit_window_is_part_of_the_registration.long_history_arm: energy_generation offers 678-1780 additional days per pair. Fitting them is a DIFFERENT experiment and is not licensed by this registration. It is permitted only as a second arm declared before fitting, with both arms reported whenever the long arm is run. Funding it is a CEO sequencing and budget call.
fit_window_is_part_of_the_registration.shopping_prohibition: Fitting the short window, observing a failed cell, then refitting on the long window and reporting the pass, voids this registration for that pair.

per_pair_bar_measured_before_any_challen.protocol: Literal seasonal-naive D-7 over the registered gate window on the plain hourly :00 target series, read through db.load_renewable_type_data on the live replica (9,432,453,120 bytes, mode=ro) 2026-08-12, under .venv Python 3.14.3 / xgboost 3.3.0. No model existed for any of these pairs when these were taken. The harness's per-band, finite-intersection D-7 is the authoritative gate number and will differ slightly; these are the pre-committed bar.

reading_caveats_not_band_changes.southern_solar_bar_is_tight: ABL-253 read solar against D-7 bars of 22.8-32.9% (BE/DE/FR). Tranche solar bars run 7.11% (IT), 11.78% (ES), 12.67% (CH), 13.09% (PT), 16.43% (HR) - Mediterranean July/August solar is nearly D-7 periodic. Same band, materially harder task. A lower southern pass rate is not model quality.
reading_caveats_not_band_changes.small_fleet_wind_bar_is_loose: HU 125.38%, RO 104.14%, LT 100.36%, HR 99.58%, LV 97.11%. A pass there is not model strength.
reading_caveats_not_band_changes.CH_wind_onshore_is_not_decision_grade: gate-window mean 12.9 MW (ABL-318 max 198.6 MW). WAPE on a ~13 MW series cannot carry a promotion decision either way. Registration-compatible; report it, do not decide on it.
reading_caveats_not_band_changes.GR_tables_are_different_series: GR solar is the only pair where the tables materially disagree inside the gate window: 81.2% of hours bit-identical, mean abs diff 130.36 MW = 4.88% of level, max 1342.0 MW. Its evidence pack must report this and a GR gate read must not be treated as interchangeable between sources.
reading_caveats_not_band_changes.first_tranche_recommendation: BG solar, CH solar, BG wind_onshore, then CH wind_onshore as build-and-report. The four BG/CH pairs are level across both tables, 720/720 gate hours and D-7-scorable in each, bit-identical in all 720 co-observed hours, no ABL-188 hit in either window.

contamination.ABL-67: net_position only - does not intersect these targets. GR provenance flag only.
contamination.ABL-71: known wrong-write modes are load and net position; a provenance caveat, not proof solar/wind ingest is pristine.
contamination.ABL-188: DOES intersect. Five hits inside the registered windows, four of them energy_renewable-only: CZ solar fit -93h, CZ wind_onshore fit -86h, NL solar fit -45h (all energy_renewable only), EE solar gate -45h (BOTH tables). The screen is applied to both sources by db.load_renewable_type_data, so handling is identical between arms.

harness_prerequisite: ABL-345 gives both gate harnesses --actuals-source. Until it lands, a harness run for these pairs fits on energy_renewable through the global default and this registration is not satisfied. ABL-345 is the Founding Engineer's; nothing in this registration is blocked on measuring it again.
voids_this_registration: any change to the windows, bands, metric, baseline, minimum n, source table, or the not_evaluable list after a challenger score has been seen for the affected pair
promotion: none. Evidence only. Promotion is a CEO-to-Board decision.
artifact_location: experiments/ABL348/artifacts (local generated output; not a serving registry)
